mechanism_story: Geometric patterns are objectively testable only when pivot confirmation and tolerance are frozen causally; they remain a separate pattern-family control rather than subjective chart annotation.

priority_reason: algorithmic pattern evidence exists, but first Compression Release W3 does not need a broad named-pattern tournament

baseline_to_beat: matched random, equal-spaced and round-number zones
priority_reason: negative specificity evidence makes this a control, not a first-class W3 candidate

formula.plain_language: Represent a causal sequence of confirmed alternating legs and incomplete path candidates without assuming one deterministic five-wave truth.

enumerate a frozen small set of ordered leg grammars
retain multiple candidate parses when ambiguous
ablate ordered grammar against generic swing geometry before any authority claim

mechanism_story: Ordered impulse/correction structure may encode useful path state, but supportive Elliott studies are hybrid and do not establish a universal deterministic wave law. Mastermind should test only incremental ordered-path information beyond generic causal swing geometry.
known_failure_modes: multiple candidate counts after the same prefix
per-name outcome audition would overfit path labels
baseline_to_beat: generic causal swing geometry with the same feature budget
priority_reason: high strategic relevance to cycle forecasting, but only as an ablation-tested probabilistic path representation after the first W3 vertical
